name: Breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
summary: A one-line trail under the hero of interior ism.bible pages that shows where the page sits and links back up each level.
whenToUse: Use it on interior pages two or more levels deep: "Home / About ISM / Statement of Faith".
whenNotToUse: Do not use it on the home page or on top-level section pages (the header already shows the section).
Do not use it as primary navigation or inside app screens. Section switching on one page belongs in Tabs.

anatomy.description: A `nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]` holding an `ol.nv-bc`. Each level is an `li` with a link and a `/` separator; the last item is a `span[aria-current="page"]`, not a link. Truncated trail (more than four levels): On dark heroes add `.nv-bc-dark` to the `ol`.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail from "Home" down to the current page. The last item is the current page and is not linked.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
Component used to render links. Defaults to `'a'`.
Pass `next/link` (or any component accepting `href`, `className` and `children`) for client-side routing.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Trails longer than this fold the middle into a "…" menu, keeping the first item and the last two.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Builds the accessible name of the "…" button from the number of hidden levels.

variantNotes: **Hover:** link turns `var(--black)` with an underline (offset 3px). `.nv-hover` forces it for docs.

**Truncated:** keep the first item and the last two; fold the middle into `.nv-bc-more` (a 32x28 `var(--gray-100)` chip). Open: `aria-expanded="true"`, the chip gets the blue outline and `.nv-bc-menu` drops below (220px, `var(--radius-md)`, `var(--shadow-overlay)`). Menu rows are 44px; hover is `var(--blue-tint)`.
**On dark (`.nv-bc-dark`):** links `rgba(255,255,255,.7)`, hover and current `var(--white)`, separators `rgba(255,255,255,.35)`. Use on `var(--black)` or `var(--charcoal-900)` heroes.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Use `/` as the separator. Never use › (that means "drills into an app screen") or ↗.
Make the last item plain text with `aria-current="page"`. Never link the current page.
Keep links at 44px tap height (`.nv-bc a` has `min-height:44px`).
Set it at 14px under the hero, aligned to the page `.wrap`, above the page title.
Use the page's real titles, matching the header submenus ("About ISM", "Resources").
Over four levels: show first + last two and fold the rest into the … menu.
Wrap on narrow screens; never truncate a label with an ellipsis mid-word.

accessibility: Wrap the list in `nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"` and use an ordered list.
Hide separators from screen readers with `aria-hidden="true"`.
The … button names what it hides: `aria-label="Show 2 more levels"`, plus `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
Close the … menu on Esc and on click outside; return focus to the button.
content: Labels are the page names in Title Case, as in the header: "Home / Resources / HD Radio Broadcast".
Start with "Home", never "ISM" or the logo.
Keep each label short; drop words like "Page" or "Overview".

html:

  2. About ISM/
  3. Statement of Faith

• /
    Resources ISM Publishing
